limitations: The packet reviews existing audit candidates only; it does not collect new food data.
The current food/cooking audit is intentionally conservative and not a final recall target.
Rows are selected deterministically by review cell and stable hash, not by model judgment.
Pending or agent labels are QA surfaces and must not be treated as approved overlay data.

manual_review_policy.promotion_rule: Labels calibrate source-signal quality only. No food/cooking candidate is product-ready until it is promoted through a reviewed overlay/policy artifact.
